# My Neuro Health

My Neuro Health is a UK-based neurodevelopmental assessment service.

## Current service
- Adult ADHD assessment: available now.
- Child ADHD assessment: coming soon.
- Autism assessment: not currently advertised or offered on this public website.
- In-house ADHD medication prescribing/titration: not currently offered.

## Core pages
- https://myneurohealth.co.uk/adult-adhd.html
- https://myneurohealth.co.uk/child-adhd.html
- https://myneurohealth.co.uk/how-it-works.html
- https://myneurohealth.co.uk/about.html
- https://myneurohealth.co.uk/referrers.html

## Brand values: NEURO
Neurodiversity, Empathy, Understanding, Respect, Outcomes.
